options.prompt: Art style, identical for every asset in this game: chunky rounded vector game icon, thick dark navy outline #1E2340 with smooth even thickness, flat saturated fills with one crisp glossy highlight in the upper left and one darker shade plane at the bottom, exactly two shading steps, no gradient banding, no airbrush softness, no canvas texture. Palette: warm gold #FFC13B for frames and rims, coral red #FF5B5B for health and damage, mint green #6ED66E for healing, sky blue #4FC3F7 for water and cold, violet #9A6BE0 for special effects, deep navy #1E2340 for outlines. Never use a rough charcoal outline, visible brush strokes, oil paint texture or watercolour wash. Viewpoint: front or slight three-quarter oblique, chosen for readability. Theme: a kitchen where a chef fights rebel fruits, upgrade icons. Sprite sheet layout: a 3 columns by 2 rows grid of 6 separate icons on a fully transparent background. Each cell holds exactly one object centred with generous empty margin around it, objects never touch each other or the cell edges, every object fully opaque and saturated, readable in silhouette at 64x64 pixels. No grid lines, no cell borders, no frames, no text, no labels, no digits, no watermark, no drop shadow, no pixel art. Reading left to right, top to bottom: (1) a red chili pepper crossed with a small chef's knife, attack power boost; (2) a steel whisk with three short motion speed lines behind it, attack speed boost; (3) a hearty bowl of stew with a coral red heart floating above it, maximum health boost; (4) a chef's shoe with a small white wing on the heel, movement speed boost; (5) a mint green macaron with a small glowing plus cross above it, healing macaron; (6) three kitchen knives fanned out in a stack, multi hit boost.
